rule: Official vendor repositories whose GitHub licence interface names an allowlisted licence; the generator reads each file at the branch's head commit, proves its bytes by git blob identity, and decides the licence again from the licence text at that commit. directory_names and directory_providers name the APIs.guru directory entries a source already supplies; the directory mode leaves them to this source (GitHub as a whole provider, so the enterprise server variants do not repeat its operations; SendGrid as a whole provider, whose single directory specification repeats the curated files).
